 Racing League Tools 

 To update from previous versions, please click the "Check for updates" button in the Help menu. 

A complex solution for the most convenient management of the racing league of any level and format. The app is based on a database in which you can store drivers, race results and much more. Advanced rendering engine provides options for generation images with results, standings, line-ups, statistics, etc. 

 Key features: 
- Support for racing formats of any complexity 
- Fully automated point and standings calculation 
- Managing multiple seasons with different championships 
- Multiuser support with cloud database synchronization 
- Extended support for F1 Codemasters game serires, including getting results from UDP telemetry 

 Example of a generated race results image 

Requirements: 
Windows 10 (1903 and above), Windows 11. 
300 Mb free disc space (700 Mb for auto update function), preferably on SSD. 
Only portable version, just extract archive to any folder and run "RacingLeagueTools.exe". 

 CHAMPIONSHIPS 

v0.7.x includes the following built-in championships: 
- F1 2020 
- F1 2021 (short and full qual formats, multiplayer car format) 
- F1 2022 (short and full qual formats) 
- F2 2020 
- F2 2021 (1, 2 or 3 races per event) 
- Assetto Corsa Competizione 

 Championships page 

You can create your own custom championship, including custom teams, cars, circuits with customizable event format and point system. 

 Point system page 

 DRIVERS & SEASONS 

You can create, import/export drivers, assign to them custom league categories, graphic badges, etc. The next step is to determine the team-based or car-based line-ups for a specific season: 

 Line-ups page 

Create an unlimited number of seasons based on different championships. And then add events to the calendar: 

 Seasons page 

Season features: 
- splitting by custom league's categories 
- up to 3 races, 3 qualifications, 1 practice per one event 
- dynamically add / delete additional sessions to the event 
- dynamically change race and qualification sessions type 
- custom grid size up to 60 drivers 
- custom seat number per team, support reserve seats 
- support short / full qualification format (F1 2021) 

 SESSION RESULTS 

The app provides the most convenient and advanced functions for inputting session results. 

 Sessions page 

You only need to press one key to select the desired driver: 

 The session results table supports the following data: 
- Driver, team or car, time/gap, fastest lap, grid position, driver and team points 
- Various penalty fields, such as: time penalty by game or by stewards, position penalty by game or by stewards, penalty points. 

Classification positions and points are calculated automatically, but you can manually control these values. 
Export of results in csv format is supported. 

 RENDERING 

Version 0.7.0 introduces a new rendering engine that allows you to create render images of almost any complexity. More information on the Discord server. 

An advanced rendering system allows you to generate final images of great quality: 

 Example of a generated line-ups image 

 Example of a generated driver standings image 

The following types of rendering are currently supported: 
- race results, qualification and full qualification (mixed of Q1, Q2, Q3) results, practice results. 
- season's line-ups, including permanent and reserve seats 
- driver and team standings 
- race statistics: pure race pace (*), consistancy rating (*), top fastest laps, longest stints. 

The app supports custom graphics mods for rendering, you can change many of the settings yourself or download a ready-made custom mod. 

 STATISTICS 

The app saves lap data (lap and sector times, etc) for each driver from a session received using UDP telemetry. This data can be processed by this functions or exported: 

 Pure race pace (*) 

The purpose of this rating is to show as objectively as possible the true speed of each driver. For this, an in-depth analysis of the data of each sector of each lap of the race is used. In addition, comparative rankings for each sector (S1, S2, S3) are presented here for the first time. They show how well each driver drives each of these sectors compared to other drivers. 

 Consistency rating (*) 

Consistency rating compares drivers to each other in the ability to consistently drive lap by lap, sector by sector. 

 Longest stints and Top fastest laps 
 (*) - advanced features, available only for users who supported this project. 

Season's statistics 

 The new version has a function to calculate the season's statistics: 
- Average points, race and qual positions 
- Finishes percent, best finishes series 
- Average and sum penalties 
- Tyres usage, etc 

 All of these are just part of the features of Racing League Tools. 
More information on our Discord server .
